rows.text: To reflect stronger organic revenue growth, and changes in the M&A and foreign exchange impacts, the company is raising its full-year 2026 guidance for revenue to be between $17,275 million and $17,475 million, for Adjusted EBITDA to be between $4,000 million and $4,050 million and for Adjusted Diluted Earnings per Share to be between $12.80 and $13.00.
